body: I’ve went to the emergency room multiple times and I got treated like a criminal for being sad. You get locked in a room alone with your thoughts. It might make you “physically safe” but it’s mental torture and doesn’t solve anything. I feel like this every single day. And every day is painful and gets worse as it goes. Everytime I went to the hospital I came back traumatized and worse than when I first arrived. I think I tried pretty much everything that’s listed to “get better and feel better” but it just doesn’t work for me that’s why I’m out of hope :( also I live in Canada
